definitions.gloss: burden, load, share (of expenses or responsibility)
definitions.explanation: Something that one must bear or be responsible for, especially costs or duties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{各自|かくじ}→各自：00157_kakuji⟧{負担|ふたん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Each person will bear their own expenses.

examples.japanese: {医療|いりょう}⟦{費|ひ}→費：03588_hiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{負担|ふたん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大|おお}きい。
examples.english: The burden of medical expenses is heavy.

examples.japanese: {身体|からだ}⟦への→への：00314_ni⟧{負担|ふたん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{減|へ}らす。
examples.english: To reduce the strain on the body.

notes:
{負担|ふたん} refers to a burden or responsibility one must bear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {負担|ふたん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}ける: to impose a burden on
- {負担|ふたん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大|おお}きい: the burden is heavy
- {負担|ふたん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{減|へ}らす: to reduce the burden
- {自己|じこ}{負担|ふたん}: self-payment, out-of-pocket expense

USAGE:
- For expenses: ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{負担|ふたん}する (to bear the costs)
- For physical strain: {身体|からだ}⟦への→への：00314_ni⟧{負担|ふたん} (strain on the body)
